findings.obligation: AC3: a connection without write consent never tries to write
findings.observation: The guard blocks only when the credential lacks the rights the connection NEEDS (NeededWorkItemRights: mappings count > 0): "return credential?.LacksRightsFor(connection.NeededWorkItemRights) ?? false;". A Read credential on a connection with no mappings loaded still writes. Write-back updates come from mappings, so unreachable in practice, and recorded in feature-delta as an AFK decision; non-blocking
findings.remediation: Optional hardening: block on ConsentedRights == Read alone; costs one design change and one oracle row (the test A_read_only_sign_in_does_not_block_a_write_while_the_connection_has_no_write_back_mapping would flip)
